title: Process
description: Represents a data transformation or ETL process that creates lineage between assets. A Process connects input assets to output assets, showing data flow through transformations.

properties.name: guid
properties.description: Globally unique identifier for this process.

properties.name: qualifiedName
properties.description: Unique name for this process. Typically includes connection and process identifiers.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description of what this process does.

properties.name: inputs
properties.description: Input assets consumed by this process. These are the source assets in the lineage.

properties.name: outputs
properties.description: Output assets produced by this process. These are the target assets in the lineage.

properties.name: sql
properties.description: SQL query or transformation logic used by this process.

properties.name: code
properties.description: Code or script for the transformation.

properties.name: ast
properties.description: Abstract syntax tree representation of the transformation.

properties.name: connectionName
properties.description: Simple name of the connection this process belongs to.

properties.name: connectionQualifiedName
properties.description: Qualified name of the connection this process belongs to.

properties.name: createdBy
properties.description: User or account that created this process.

properties.name: updatedBy
properties.description: User or account that last updated this process.

properties.name: createTime
properties.description: Time (epoch) at which this process was created, in milliseconds.

properties.name: updateTime
properties.description: Time (epoch) at which this process was last updated, in milliseconds.
